text:
Mateo: Quick win to share — OpenHarbor Logistics signed a 12-month Dedicated contract with a reseller co-sell via HarborSys. Pilot finished today, and customer reported a ~3x latency improvement and ~45% inference unit cost reduction after switching to Redwood Dedicated. Huge props to Eng & Sales. :tada:

Jess: Amazing — ACV is $420k, starts next month. Need logo approval and an official customer quote for the case study. Who's owning the write-up?

Clare: Marketing can own the case study and the co-branded GTM assets. @Mateo can you share customer contact + a short quote draft? We should also aim for a 30s customer testimonial video if they’re open.

Mateo: Customer contact is Lucy Park (Head of ML) — lucy.openharbor@openharbor.com. Draft quote from the pilot they approved: "Redwood's Dedicated offering let us scale inference with predictable latency and cut unit costs dramatically — it unlocked a new realtime feature for our routing platform." Feel free to edit.

Riley: Eng notes from onboarding: used `redwood deploy --env private --region us-east-1 --pool dedicated-us-1` and enabled per-customer KV caching + quantized weights. Sustained 120 QPS, p95 ~60ms for 512 tokens in steady-state. We have perf graphs to attach.

Anil: I'll compile before/after benchmarks and a short timeline (pilot -> ga). Plan: reproduce the baseline, run the tuned config, and pull cost-per-token numbers. ETA: next Tue.

Jess: Legal needs explicit logo + testimonial consent. @Clare can you loop in Legal? Also, who will own the joint press release with HarborSys?

Clare: On it — looping Legal and Partner Comms now. Proposed cadence: draft case study by Fri, customer review early next week, publish two weeks after customer sign-off. We should align HarborSys for the co-sell mention and marketplace listing collateral.

Mateo: Next operational steps: 1) Legal/Marketing sync (Clare) 2) Eng to hand off perf graphs (Riley) 3) Sales to secure final quote and PO details (Jess) 4) PM (Anil) drafts timeline and metrics section. I'll create invites this afternoon.

Riley: Also flagging one engineering follow-up — customer used a custom tokenizer which changed token counts by ~8%, we should include that in the case study notes so numbers are apples-to-apples.

Jess: Noted. I'll ask Lucy for approval on the quote and permission for the video.

deploy-bot: Deployment `dedicated-us-1` completed for openharbor-prod at 2026-03-23T14:02:01Z — no errors.

Mateo: Love it. Team, big win. Will post a formal Slack announcement once Legal signs off on assets. :rocket:
